taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: Anything that would make next week easier?
A one-page list of who to ask for what (like IT, payroll, or SAP access) would be really helpful. Last week I spent an hour just trying to find who could reset my SAP password.
How did spending an hour on the SAP password reset affect your tasks that day?
It just pushed back my other work a bit, but I was still able to catch up and get everything done.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee requested a reference guide for internal contacts after spending an hour finding assistance for a password reset.
